name: Selene Synth
about: Modular-style melodic sounds: 8 live synths (bass, acid, lead, pad, drone, pluck, bell, West-coast) and 4 stereo banks (textures, drones, chord stabs, sweeps).

modtex.about: evolving stereo textures, 5-7 s, rooted on C (note transposes); :0 dark and low … :15 bright and glassy

moddrone.about: stereo drones, 6 s; moddrone:N is on pitch class N (0 C, 1 Db, 2 D, 3 Eb, 4 E, 5 F, 6 Gb, 7 G, 8 Ab, 9 A, 10 Bb, 11 B), so pick the key's root

modstab.about: stereo dub chord stabs rooted on C (note transposes): :0-3 minor (m m7 m9 m11), :4-7 major (maj maj7 maj9 6/9), :8-11 open (sus2 sus4 7sus4 quartal), :12-15 tense (7 9 dim7 aug)

modsweep.about: stereo filter sweeps: :0-7 falls 0.6-2.5 s, :8-15 risers 1-4 s that stop dead at the top (start a riser so it ends on a downbeat)

synbass.about: live bass, a sub sine plus a filtered saw; play it low with # octave 3 (or 4); the note lasts the step, so use legato for longer ones

knobs.slide: semitones it glides up into the note

synacid.about: live acid bass, a saw through a resonant ladder filter; play it low with # octave 3 (or 4), in 16ths with legato 0.5-0.9; the note lasts the step

knobs.slide: semitones it glides up into the note (2 is a classic slide)

synlead.about: live mono lead, two pulse waves with PWM, glide and vibrato; the note lasts the step

knobs.slide: semitones it glides up into the note

synpad.about: live stereo pad of detuned saws, for chords (n "c'min7" # octave 4); it swells in over the note, so give it long notes (one chord per cycle, or legato 1-2)

syndrone.about: live stereo drone, three slowly beating oscillators; give it long notes (slow 4, or legato 4)

synpluck.about: live plucked string (Karplus-Strong); rings for its decay whatever the step, good for arpeggios

synbell.about: live FM bell; rings for its decay whatever the step

knobs.voice: FM ratio: 0, 0.33, 0.67, 1 sound harmonic and mellow, values between clang (0.47 is a bell)

synlpg.about: live West-coast voice, a folded sine through a low-pass gate: woody, struck, rings for its decay; good for sequences
